# telnyx_global_ip_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a Global IP to a WireGuard peer, so traffic to the address goes over that peer's tunnel. Assignment completes in the background.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deliver traffic for the Global IP over the laptop peer's tunnel.
resource "telnyx_global_ip_assignment" "edge" {
  global_ip_id      = telnyx_global_ip.edge.id
  wireguard_peer_id = telnyx_wireguard_peer.laptop.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `global_ip_id` (String) Global IP ID.
- `is_in_maintenance` (Boolean) Enable/disable BGP announcement.
- `wireguard_peer_id` (String) Wireguard peer ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `is_announced` (Boolean) Status of BGP announcement.
- `is_connected` (Boolean) Wireguard peer is connected.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `status` (String) The current status of the interface deployment.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.

## Import
